scenario.label_zh: 试穿运动鞋并确认尺码
scenario.goal_zh: 比较试穿感受并选定合脚的一双鞋

context_zh: 雅拉试穿运动鞋时发现前端挤脚，店员提供同款不同宽度供她比较。
author: author-phase06-b

sentences.speaker: Yara
sentences.text: My big toe is pressed against the side of this shoe. The length seems fine, though.

sentences.speaker: Sports Shop Assistant
sentences.text: That's the standard width. We also have a wider version in the same size.

sentences.speaker: Yara
sentences.text: Could I try it? I don't want a longer shoe just to get more room at the front.

sentences.speaker: Sports Shop Assistant
sentences.text: Certainly. Walk around in these and tell me how they feel.

sentences.speaker: Yara
sentences.text: Unlike the first pair, these don't squeeze my toes. My heels aren't slipping either.

sentences.speaker: Yara
sentences.text: Yes, I'll take the wider ones in this size.
